## Chelsea Handed Huge Joao Pedro Blow As Xabi Alonso Confirms Major Injury Setback Ahead Of Liverpool Tie

Xabi Alonso has ruled Joao Pedro out of Chelsea's Carabao Cup clash with Liverpool and provided an update on the striker's injury. [...] Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola also hinted at his rotation plans in his press conference on Tuesday afternoon.

“There will definitely be changes, but we want to win the game. We want to be competitive,” he explained.

“We need to see where the legs are and make some changes game-to-game because it's almost mandatory.”
